title: Design System: GrowGuide UK — Gravity Rain

headline.purpose: Compact dashboard promises and surface introductions.

body.purpose: Plain instructions, summaries, task detail, and privacy copy.

label.purpose: Forecast days, plot facts, crop groups, and timing metadata.

shadows.name: matte
shadows.purpose: Defined low ambient compatibility token; core Gravity Rain surfaces remain border-led and flat.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Defined one-pixel compatibility edge; not used by rebuilt dashboard surfaces.

shadows.name: lifted
shadows.purpose: Alias of matte retained by the Tailwind theme; not a default card treatment.

motion.name: rain-path-draw
motion.purpose: Draw authored setup rain paths and the desktop forecast-to-action trajectory once, then stop.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Tailwind default transition for colour and opacity state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, remove path drawing while keeping the final path and all content visible.

components.css: .ds-forecast { display: flex; gap: 20px; overflow-x: auto; border: 1px solid rgb(231 232 228 / 0.2); border-radius: 0; background: var(--garden-ground, #20312C); color: var(--pale-mineral, #E7E8E4); padding: 20px; font-family: var(--font-figtree), sans-serif; } .ds-current { display: flex; min-width: 176px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-right: 24px; border-right: 1px solid rgb(231 232 228 / 0.2); } .ds-current div, .ds-day { display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-current strong { font-size: 30px; line-height: 1; } .ds-current span:last-child, .ds-day span { font-size: 14px; } .ds-weather-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: none; fill: none; stroke: var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); stroke-width: 1.7; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-forecast-label { color: var(--moss-veil, #A6B49C); font-size: 12px !important; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-day { min-width: 88px; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; text-align: center; } .ds-rain { color: var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); font-size: 12px !important; }

components.name: Rain-to-Action Cue
components.description: One-shot authored weather trajectory that terminates at a real, local action cue.
components.html: Rain ahead — check the soil before watering.
components.css: .ds-rain-action { position: relative; min-height: 96px; color: var(--garden-ground, #20312C); font-family: var(--font-figtree), sans-serif; } .ds-rain-trajectory { position: absolute; inset: 0 0 auto auto; width: 55%; height: 64px; overflow: visible; fill: none; } .ds-rain-reveal { fill: none; stroke: white; stroke-width: 5; stroke-dasharray: 1; stroke-linecap: round; animation: ds-rain-draw 900ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-rain-visible { fill: none; stroke: var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-dasharray: 3 3; stroke-linecap: round; vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; } .ds-action-cue { position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; width: 42%; border-left: 1px solid var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); padding-left: 12px; } .ds-action-cue span { display: block; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); } .ds-action-cue p { margin: 8px 0 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } @keyframes ds-rain-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset: 1; } to { stroke-dashoffset: 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-rain-reveal { animation: none; stroke-dashoffset: 0; } }

components.css: .ds-task { position: relative; display: flex; gap: 12px; border: 1px solid rgb(32 49 44 / 0.4); border-radius: 0; background: var(--pale-mineral, #E7E8E4); color: var(--garden-ground, #20312C); padding: 20px 4px 20px 20px; font-family: var(--font-figtree), sans-serif; } .ds-task-rail { position: absolute; inset: 0 auto 0 0; width: 4px; background: var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); } .ds-task-check { position: relative; display: flex; width: 44px; height: 44px; flex: none; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-task-check input { width: 24px; height: 24px; appearance: none; border: 1px solid rgb(32 49 44 / 0.5); border-radius: 0; background: var(--pale-mineral, #E7E8E4); } .ds-task-check input:checked { border-color: var(--garden-ground, #20312C); background: var(--garden-ground, #20312C); } .ds-task-check input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--garden-ground, #20312C); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-task-check svg { position: absolute; width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: var(--pale-mineral, #E7E8E4); stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; } .ds-task-check input:checked + svg { opacity: 1; } .ds-task h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.375; } .ds-task p { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.625; } .ds-task-label { color: rgb(32 49 44 / 0.65); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-task-weather { border-left: 2px solid var(--sky-blue, #7DB8E6); color: var(--rain-ink, #285F87); padding-left: 12px; }

narrative.overview:
Gravity Rain is a calm, practical working system in which local weather visibly bends the interface toward the action it changes. Its signature composition, Rain to Action, treats forecast paths, timing lines, and a dark flower marker as information architecture rather than decoration. The system feels sophisticated through precision: one humanist sans, matte surfaces, fine boundaries, restrained colour, and generous working space.

The interface is quiet but not passive. Dark forecast regions establish local conditions; blue motion traces a real consequence; coral and moss identify protection and growth states; the factual plot profile and short priority list complete the thought. Copy stays concise, plain, and encouraging. Setup, privacy, loading, error, and empty states explain only what is needed for the next decision, with no invented claims or decorative gardening language.
keyCharacteristics: Weather visibly leads to a useful action.
Matte mineral surfaces are structured by fine lines, not floating cards.
A single humanist sans keeps operational information direct.
Authored Rainline GG and black-flower marks replace generic gardening symbols.
Colour is semantic: blue for weather/action, coral for protection/urgency, moss for planting/healthy states.
Mobile keeps priorities before plot context and never compresses labels into illegibility.

rules.name: The Weather Carries Blue Rule
rules.body: Use Rain Ink for action and Sky Blue for weather paths and symbols; blue must explain local conditions or what to do next.

rules.name: The Signal Stays Singular Rule
rules.body: Coral identifies protection, error, or time-sensitive risk; moss identifies growth and selection. Do not use either as general decoration.

rules.name: The One Workhorse Rule
rules.body: Use Figtree throughout; do not introduce a serif, script, or ornamental gardening face.

rules.name: The Minimal Copy Rule
rules.body: Lead with the next decision, use plain UK English, and omit kickers, repeated reassurance, and explanatory copy that does not change an action.

rules.name: The Action Before Context Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens, show what needs doing before the factual plot profile; never preserve desktop column order at the cost of the next useful action.

rules.name: The Matte by Default Rule
rules.body: Keep working surfaces flat at rest; establish depth with Garden Ground boundaries, dark/light reversal, and spatial grouping rather than floating card shadows.

rules.name: The Fine Edge Rule
rules.body: Start square and use one-pixel rules; add curvature only when the shape itself communicates a point, marker, or path.

rules.name: The Rain Must Land Rule
rules.body: Never draw a weather trajectory unless it terminates at a real, deterministic action generated from available weather state.

rules.name: The Authored Marks Rule
rules.body: Never substitute a sprout, seedling, leaf-in-circle, Unicode flower, or generic gardening badge for Rainline GG or the black-flower anchor.

dos: Do use Pale Mineral as the working canvas and Garden Ground for structure, focus, and dark functional bands.
Do preserve the forecast → action → plot → season reading order, adapting actions before plot on phones.
Do keep every interactive target at least 44px high, keyboard reachable, clearly labelled, and visibly focused.
Do keep essential content visible without animation; respect reduced motion by showing the final path without drawing it.
Do write short, plain, factual copy and expose errors, status changes, required fields, and selected states semantically.
Do use authored SVG for identity, weather symbols, checkmarks, and plot markers.
donts: Don't use gradients, glass effects, floating generic card grids, broad soft shadows, or cream-and-terracotta editorial styling.
Don't introduce a display serif, ornamental gardening type, or decorative text that competes with the next action.
Don't use blue, coral, or moss without their weather/action, protection/error, or planting/selection meaning.
Don't invent measured plot geometry, weather cues, claims, pop-ups, or additional explanatory copy.
Don't shrink forecast, timeline, or form labels to preserve a desktop layout on phones; scroll, stack, or switch control form instead.
Don't animate continuously or make an action, cue, label, or path depend on animation or JavaScript effects to remain understandable.
